How should the notch grow when the conversation is open and the expanded
view needs more height than the panel allows?

❯ 1. Resize the existing panel downward
     Keep one window; grow its frame and pin the top edge.
  2. Add a second child window
     The expanded area lives in its own borderless panel.
  3. Type something.
